subject.title: fix(onepassword): key pending authorizations by tool call id only

question: Should authorization correlation be guaranteed by the generic `before_tool_call` composition contract, or moved to a plugin/core opaque channel that other hooks cannot replace?
rationale: Both choices affect a security-sensitive cross-boundary contract; a plugin-local nonce in ordinary adjusted params is not reliable under the current hook merger, while changing generic composition semantics could affect existing plugins.

options.title: Guarantee additive hook params
options.body: Define and test a core composition rule that preserves independent parameter additions while resolving same-key conflicts deterministically.

options.title: Add an opaque correlation seam
options.body: Carry authorization state through a dedicated core-owned field or token channel that is unavailable to the model and unaffected by parameter rewrites.

options.title: Pause the nonce approach
options.body: Do not land this PR until a supported cross-hook correlation contract exists and can be proven on a real gateway.

recommendation.title: Guarantee additive hook params
recommendation.body: Define and test a core composition rule that preserves independent parameter additions while resolving same-key conflicts deterministically.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged feature history and this follow-up place the affected authorization invariants closest to this contributor's current work.
